LOAD-BEARING INVARIANTS enforced: (1) RULE-004 no direct external send (leg 1) -- the conversions endpoint + enqueue seam hold NO Transport (only write outbox rows); only the dispatcher workers hold a Transport; StagedBlockedTransport raises ExternalSendBlocked so even the worker makes no real call; a blocked send -> item HELD (QUEUED + EXTERNAL_SEND_OFF note), not lost. (2) RULE-002 two-checkpoint consent (SMK-002, FAIL-002) -- consent referenced at conversion creation (checkpoint 1) and RE-VALIDATED at dispatch via ConsentGate.permits_send (checkpoint 2); a consent-invalid item is a policy-block -> terminal DEAD_LETTER(reason)+audit, NEVER delivered (transport.deliver not called); a lapsed-at-send consent is also blocked; member opt-out -> audience REMOVE. (3) Bounded retry -> dead-letter (SMK-016, leg 2) -- a transient transport failure -> RETRY (error_log+next_retry_at+retry_count) -> DEAD_LETTER at max_retries; policy-block is a DISTINCT terminal non-send (not an infinite loop); no infinite retry, no silent loss; a dead-lettered row is not reprocessed. (4) Dedup RULE-005/audience -- UNIQUE dedup_key per (conversion x platform) / (segment x member x platform x op); keys HASHED (no raw PII in the key); measurement fan-out to PIXEL+CAPI (+OFFLINE only for ORDER_VERIFIED). (5) O-1 PII fail-closed -- no raw PII in dedup_key (hashed) or payload_ref (PII-safe ref; hashed payload at dispatch = M6.2D); customer_or_guest_key/member_key masked on every export. (6) RULE-012 -- audience enqueue reads membership for SYNC ONLY, triggers nothing; non-APPROVED segment enqueues nothing. PLAN-DELTAS (IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES sec.4): (a) consolidated C2/C3 into one generic OutboxStore; (b) conversion idempotency key server-derived from the conversion's OWN stable inputs (not the track RULE-005 formula -- a conversion has no page/session), client value never trusted (RULE-H03); (c) CTR-017 DEDUP_CONFLICT is documented as not-reachable (server-derived key => collision maps to the SAME key => DUPLICATE, replay-safe); (d) data_quality_pass is a fail-closed hook (HOLD default until M6.2F CTR-024; SMK-016 exercised via injected PASS + failing/succeeding transport, no real send); (e) event_in_registry enforced upstream at conversion creation (row carries no event_code; not_duplicate is structural via UNIQUE dedup_key); (f) Transport + ExternalSendBlocked separates 'no real send while OFF' (held) from 'testable transient retry' (dead-letter); (g) event_ts_bucket = UTC hour (dedup window; config granularity); dedup keys sha256-hashed (LOCKED component set/order unchanged, only serialization hashed for PII-safety); (h) 3 carried-forward files extended additively; __main__ banner still reads 'M6.2A' (carried-forward, cosmetic).
